programs.description: A filmmaker is found dead under mysterious circumstances. Years later, his son, Adi, a successful writer, digs into his past and tries to demystify the reason for his father's death.
After he witnesses his entire family getting murdered over a video call, Surya decides to avenge their deaths. His fiancée, Gayathri, who is mourning the death of her brother, is ready to help him.
In a village, an Ayurvedic doctor is famous for predicting people's death by feeling the pulse of the patient. However, the villagers realise the truth when an allopathic doctor reveals the secret.
Two friends, Ananthan and Appukuttan, set out to make a name for themselves. After losing their jobs, they venture into the real estate business and meet a girl who changes their lives.
When Jagadeesh welcomes his old friend, Sethumadhavan, into his home because he does not have a place to stay, he invites his stepmother Bhanu's wrath.
Pradeep marries Roshni without his family's consent. However, Roshni decides to move to her friend Shailaja's house with Pradeep, unaware that she is Pradeep's sister-in-law.
Charles and his group of men hijack a bus filled with politicians and demand the release of their colleagues from prison. An ex-police officer, Ali Imran, is summoned to solve the problem.
A hard-working postwoman lives a contended life with her adopted son. However, her simple life is jeopardised after her beloved son is imprisoned under a false charge.
A car that Mahadevan wins in a contest brings him bad luck, and he soon gets involved in a murder. As he tries to find a car with the same license number as his, he unravels a shocking truth.
Three young men plot to rob a busy bank during its working hours. However, their plans go haywire after someone gets murdered in the bank premises, and they are accused of the crime.
After witnessing the youth around him addicted to drugs, Shakthi, a young man, takes the help of his friend, a police officer, to fight against drug peddlers.
Bringing the best in cinema.
A father realises his mistake after his son, whom he loves dearly, kicks him out of the house. At the time, his daughters decide to help him out despite being neglected.
Jerry Matthews, a con man, breaks away from his family. One day, he meets an ex-convict with whom he plans a daunting heist.
Janu, Chandran, Nanu and Lakshmi join Madhavan's circus together. Things take a turn when Madhavan's nephew mistreats them, leading to Lakshmi's death.
Veena, a teenager, visits her maternal grandfather in Ooty with her father to commemorate her mother's 13th death anniversary. There, she learns of her parents' love story.
Enraged by the politics and corruption in and around his campus, a college student attempts to take a stand against the corrupt.
Single mother Marykutty lives a quiet life with her child. However, things take a turn when Louis, a man with mild autism, seeks shelter at her house.
